grouping: one group for every care GT word; include each frozen crop whose original-coordinate bbox IoU with that GT bbox is at least matching_iou; allow a crop in multiple groups
reference: among member crops choose the bbox nearest the coordinate-wise median, with candidate ID as tie-break; GT bbox is not supplied to the selector score
assignment: at most one crop per GT group and at most one use of each original crop

scientific_choices.choice: Paper section 3.3 supplies contour crops and section 3.5 supplies PARSeq recognition; GT grouping is not specified.
Frozen TEST crop boxes, PARSeq outputs, original GT and aligned probability maps supply the diagnostic inputs.
Oracle membership uses the existing local IoU 0.5 convention; a crop may belong to multiple GT groups; candidate-derived medoid prevents the GT box from entering the crop score.
This oracle does not estimate performance with predicted group membership or official polygon spotting evaluation.
